title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.67: Let Loose now deals its base damage once, then hits an additional time for each Unplayable in your hand (was one hit PER Unplayable, so it did nothing with none in hand). Wording/implementation follow the base game's Rattle. Still removes Unplayable from your attacks and skills.
